description: TAFDC provides Massachusetts cash assistance to eligible pregnant people, parents and relative caregivers. DTA also connects participating families with education, employment
introduction: TAFDC provides Massachusetts cash assistance to eligible pregnant people, parents and relative caregivers. DTA also connects participating families with education, employment and child care support.

who: Massachusetts residents with a dependent child, pregnant at any stage, or caring for a related child.
Family income and eligible citizenship or immigration status are assessed by DTA.
A relative caregiver may seek a child-only grant; the caregiver’s income is not counted for that application, although the child’s income may matter.
sections.get: Two cash payments each month, with access to related supports. Ask the case manager about the services available for your family and any participation requirement.
sections.docs: Prepare household identity, income and child or pregnancy information. DTA sends a verification list after the interview; tell the worker if a record is difficult to obtain.
sections.apply:
1. Select Apply TAFDC on DTA Connect, or call your local DTA office to apply by phone.
  2. Complete the interview and discuss a child-only application if relevant.
  3. Send requested verification through DTA Connect or an accepted office, mail or fax route.
sections.after: Review the decision and case notices in DTA Connect. DTA says applications are decided within 30 days. Most families have six-month reevaluations, with some twelve-month cases. Ask whether time limits apply and discuss any extension before the limit is reached.

faqs: Can I apply before my baby is born?
Yes, pregnancy at any stage is a listed eligibility pathway.
Can a grandparent apply just for a child?
A related caregiver can ask for a child-only grant.
Do all families have the same time limit?
Ask your case manager; some families face a 24-month limit in a five-year period and may request an extension.
Call your local DTA office for a phone application.
Where do I find my worker?
Case manager contact information is available through DTA Connect.
